name: The Genial Outsider
description: +3sM if you have 2 or fewer Drops of Life in your trait pile. +6sM if you also have 3 or fewer actions.

name: The Bush Kid
description: +3sM if you have 3 or more Drops of Life in your trait pile. +6sM if you also have 5 or more actions.

name: The Silent Elder
description: If you have 4 or fewer of each color in your trait pile, reveal the top 1 card of the trait deck. If you have 3 or fewer of each color, reveal 5. Add all revealed face values of 4 or lower to your final score, then remove the revealed cards from the game.

name: The Painter
description: +3sM for each color in your trait pile whose count is an even number. Colors with 0 traits don't count.

name: The Child and the Bear
description: +1sM for every color pair in your trait pile that shares a color with a dominant. Max +5sM. +2sM for every pair if you have 2 dominants with the same color. Max +10sM. Dominant traits do not count toward color pairs for these bonuses.

name: The Parrot's Riddle
description: +9sM and -2sM for each action in your trait pile.

name: The Monkey Thief
description: +8sM and -3sM for each Drop of Life in your trait pile.

name: The Lunar Guard
description: +4sM if your trait pile is missing 1 color or colorless. +9sM if it's missing at least 2 colors, or at least 1 color and colorless.

name: The Diamond Butterfly
description: +2sM if your trait pile has fewer blue traits than your opponents (including ties). +2sM for fewer green traits (including ties). +6sM if you achieve both goals.

name: The Ruby Tortoise
description: +2sM if your trait pile has fewer green traits than your opponents (including ties). +2sM for fewer purple traits (including ties). +6sM if you achieve both goals.

name: The Clashing Crabs
description: +4sM if you have more negative face-value traits than traits with a face value of 4 or higher. +8sM if you have an equal number of both, or none of either.

name: Thunder Frogs
description: +2sM for each different color in your trait pile that has exactly one trait with a face value of 2.

name: The Armored Melon
description: +3sM if you have 3–5 cards in hand. +6sM if you have 6 or more.

name: The Stylite
description: +3sM if your Drop of Life bonus is 3–6. +7sM if it's 2 or less.

name: The Golden Shrew
description: +4sM if you have 9–12 traits in your trait pile. +7sM if you have 8 or fewer.

name: The Blind Dragon
description: To claim this bonus, you must have 5 or more of a single color in your trait pile. When scoring Meaning of Life, draw 2 Meaning of Life cards and add applicable bonuses to your final score.

name: The Blind Dragon
description: To claim this bonus, you must have 5 or more of a single color in your trait pile. When scoring Meaning of Life, draw 2 Meaning of Life cards and add applicable bonuses to your final score.

name: The Bramble Brawler
description: +4sM if you have more purple traits than your opponents, and +1sM for each opponent with fewer purple traits than you.

name: The Fire Bandit
description: +4sM if you have more red traits than your opponents, and +1sM for each opponent with fewer red traits than you.

name: The Jungler
description: +4sM if you have more colorless traits than your opponents, and +1sM for each opponent with fewer colorless traits than you.

name: The Sapphire Ladybug
description: +2sM if your trait pile has fewer purple traits than your opponents (including ties). +2sM for fewer red traits (including ties). +6sM if you achieve both goals.

name: The Emerald Slug
description: +2sM if your trait pile has fewer red traits than your opponents (including ties). +2sM for fewer blue traits (including ties). +6sM if you achieve both goals.

name: The Tracker
description: If you have all 4 colors in your trait pile, +1sM for each colorless trait in your trait pile.

name: The Truffle Hunter
description: +2sM if you have 3–5 traits with a face value of 1 in your trait pile. +6sM if you have 6 or more.

name: The Hero
description: +4sM for each dominant in your trait pile that shares its color (or colorless) with only 0–1 other trait in your trait pile, including your other dominant. +12sM if, against all odds, you have 3 dominant traits in your trait pile.

name: The Wilted Flower
description: +4sM if you are tied for the lowest Gene Pool. +7sM if you have the lowest.

name: The Medicine Master
description: +3sM if you have 1–2 negative face-value traits in your trait pile. +7sM if you have 3 or more.

name: The Fortunate Alchemist
description: +2sM if you have 2–4 traits with a face value of 0 in your trait pile, including +0. +9sM if you have 5. -4sM if you have none.

name: The River Mist
description: At World's End: reveal this card immediately. +2 to your total trait count. +4sM if you have the most traits in your trait pile, and +1sM for each opponent with fewer traits than you.

name: The Dancer
description: +12sM if you have the lowest score before Meaning of Life bonuses. +8sM if you are tied for the lowest.

name: The Fellmonger
description: +3sM if you have only 1 or 2 blue traits in your trait pile. +6sM if you have none.

name: The Magician
description: +3sM if you have only 1 or 2 colorless traits in your trait pile. +6sM if you have none.

name: The Maven
description: +3sM if you have 10–14 traits in your trait pile. +7sM if you have 15 or more.

name: The Vagrant
description: +8sM if you have fewer traits in your trait pile than your opponents. +6sM if you're tied for the fewest.

name: The Vixen
description: +3sM if you have 3–5 purple traits in your trait pile. +6sM if you have 6 or more.

name: The Rain Golem
description: +4sM if you have more blue traits than your opponents, and +1sM for each opponent with fewer blue traits than you.

name: The Forest Keeper
description: +4sM if you have more green traits than your opponents, and +1sM for each opponent with fewer green traits than you.

name: The Forest Keeper
description: +4sM if you have more green traits than your opponents, and +1sM for each opponent with fewer green traits than you.

name: The Bilbies
description: +4sM if you have only 1 dominant trait in your trait pile. +10sM if you have none.

name: The Cabochon
description: +3sM if you have only 1 or 2 red traits in your trait pile. +6sM if you have none.

name: The Cosmic Jinx
description: +4sM if your Gene Pool is 3. +8sM if your Gene Pool is 2 or less.

name: The Jellyfish
description: +3sM if you have 3–5 blue traits in your trait pile. +6sM if you have 6 or more.

name: The Logician
description: +3sM if you have 3–5 effectless traits in your trait pile. +6sM if you have 6 or more.

name: The Lumberjack
description: +3sM if you have only 1 or 2 green traits in your trait pile. +6sM if you have none.

name: The Soothsayer
description: +3sM if you have only 1 or 2 purple traits in your trait pile. +6sM if you have none.

name: The Spirit Gardener
description: +3sM if you have 3–5 colorless traits in your trait pile. +6sM if you have 6 or more.

name: The Tigris
description: +3sM if you have 3–5 traits with actions in your trait pile. +6sM if you have 6 or more.

name: The Warbler
description: +3sM if you have 3–5 green traits in your trait pile. +6sM if you have 6 or more.

name: The Warrior
description: +3sM if you have 3–5 red traits in your trait pile. +6sM if you have 6 or more.

name: The Weaver
description: +3sM for each set of all 4 colors (red, green, blue, purple) in your trait pile.
